stem: In which line from the article does the author reveal how she would like others to respond to her lack of hearing?

options.label: F
options.text: I had always hated to be seen as inferior, so I never mentioned my lack of hearing.

options.label: G
options.text: If I tell, people may see only my disability.

options.label: H
options.text: Unlike a wheelchair or a white cane, my disability doesn’t announce itself.

options.label: J
options.text: It’s a tender part, and you should handle it with care.
